title: Tone experiments with entranced space kids

plain: On Jesse Michels' podcast, a researcher whose name is not given described work done in the 1970s at the lab of Andrija Puharich, a researcher who studied psychic abilities and claimed contact with otherworldly beings. The guest says Puharich ran many experiments on children who were put into a trance, for example playing a certain tone and asking them to respond to it, and points to Puharich's recorded session tapes. If true, it would mean these children were being tested as possible channels to something beyond ordinary perception.
